cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I put my hand up with yours. Add your name to my bidding slip; we'll take the lot together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was waving at my daughter. You've bought the entire jam stall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, whole stall. Put your name beside mine and we'll agree who takes what.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The stall includes tomorrow's shift. I promised my daughter we'd go swimming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign for the stock with me first. We can divide tomorrow up once it's ours.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies a raised hand as bidding; B2 reveals a wave and A3 covers the unwanted lot while pushing joint ownership before B4 work is allocated.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 whole-stall purchase feeds A3 shared ownership; B4 shift and family conflict cause A5 stock-first signing tactic.

relationship.evidence: B4 protects a promise to a daughter, giving the refusal personal pressure rather than abstract resistance.

heightening.evidence: A5 separates attractive stock from B4 work to obtain a name before scheduling.
